headline: Illustrative crude oil supply disruption
summary: A hypothetical reduction in crude oil supply may raise oil prices and increase costs for oil-importing economies.

nodes.label: Crude Oil
nodes.description: Global crude oil supply and pricing.

nodes.label: India
nodes.description: An economy exposed to imported energy costs.

nodes.label: Indian Transportation Sector
nodes.description: Transportation businesses exposed to fuel costs.

edges.explanation: Higher crude oil prices can raise fuel costs for transportation businesses, all else equal.
limitations: Illustrative relationship; no event-specific evidence is attached.
The impact depends on fuel prices, taxes, contracts, and pass-through.

edges.explanation: Higher crude oil prices may increase the import bill of an oil-importing economy.
limitations: Illustrative relationship; not a measurement of a specific event.
The overall effect depends on exchange rates, demand, and other economic conditions.
Hypothetical scenario, not verified live news.
Relationship strengths are provisional demonstration values, not calibrated estimates.

headline: Illustrative RBI interest-rate increase
summary: A hypothetical RBI policy-rate increase may raise borrowing costs and affect credit demand.

nodes.label: RBI Policy Rate
nodes.description: The Reserve Bank of India's policy interest rate.

nodes.label: Indian Credit Demand
nodes.description: Demand for borrowing by households and businesses.

nodes.label: Indian Banking Sector
nodes.description: Banks exposed to changes in lending rates and credit demand.

edges.explanation: Higher policy rates can increase borrowing costs and reduce demand for credit, all else equal.
limitations: Illustrative relationship; no specific policy announcement is being analyzed.
Transmission depends on bank lending rates, expectations, and economic conditions.

edges.explanation: Rate changes can affect bank funding costs, lending yields, and credit quality in different ways.
limitations: The net effect varies by bank and by the speed at which deposit and lending rates adjust.
Hypothetical scenario, not a report of an actual RBI decision.
Relationship strengths are provisional demonstration values.

headline: Illustrative US Federal Reserve interest-rate increase
summary: A hypothetical Federal Reserve rate increase may affect US financial conditions and global capital flows.

nodes.label: US Federal Reserve Policy Rate
nodes.description: The US central bank's policy interest rate.

nodes.label: US Dollar
nodes.description: The US currency, affected by many economic and market factors.

nodes.label: Emerging Markets
nodes.description: Financial markets exposed to global interest rates and capital flows.

edges.explanation: Higher US rates may support the dollar if they improve relative returns, all else equal.
limitations: Currency movements also depend on expectations, other central banks, and risk sentiment.

edges.explanation: Higher US yields may make some dollar assets more attractive and pressure some emerging-market assets.
limitations: Effects vary across countries, assets, and market conditions.
Hypothetical scenario, not a report of an actual Fed decision.
Relationship strengths are provisional demonstration values.
